name: lean-guided
description: The lean surface plus a short server instruction: the default instructions' workflow and no-invent rule, said once and naming only the lean tools.
instructions: Draft FieldWorks changes through Motif; only the linguist can Apply them. Read motif_overview, motif_grammar and motif_lexicon before drafting, and copy ids exactly from their results. Make one small Proposal with motif_new_proposal, check it with motif_trial on attested forms and counterexamples, then call motif_finalize_proposal. When two analyses remain possible, ask one question grounded in project evidence. If requested forms are unattested, do not invent affixes, allomorphs or example words; ask for attested forms. If a tool you need does not exist, say so rather than working around it.

tools.description: How well the grammar analyzes the project's texts.
List grammar objects by kind, with ids.
What FieldWorks holds for one word.
Add a lexeme form (and optional gloss) to an existing entry in a draft.
Set a sense's gloss in a draft.
Parse sample words with and without the draft's changes.
Finalize the Draft so the linguist can review it.
